body:
## Question

How should entity models look and behave as they switch from icons?

Build a throwaway playground prototype over Chamonix terrain using the chosen drawing approach and the sample models. The user chooses from it:
- Enlarged models at a fixed screen size growing to real size up close, against alternatives.
- The switching distance and dead zone, in tilted and top-down views.
- An instant swap versus a brief fade between icon and model.
- Affiliation tinting, plus selection and hover treatment on models.
- Whether flat ground vehicles look wrong on slopes, which informs slope following.
- How it feels with about 100 models and 1,000 icons.

Link the prototype as an asset. Do not merge it.

Blocked by: [Choose how Ridgeline draws and loads models](https://github.com/the-Drunken-coder/Ridgeline/issues/75); [Find freely licensed sample models](https://github.com/the-Drunken-coder/Ridgeline/issues/74).

Map: [Entity models and representation switching](https://github.com/the-Drunken-coder/Ridgeline/issues/71)
title: Choose model appearance and switching behavior
